description: Room state read and closing the room at the end of a meeting.

preconditions: Online meeting just ended; its room session is still open.
cases.return: The provider room "meeting-{id}" is deleted; the open session is ended at the time the provider confirms closure (never earlier than any recorded join or leave). Open visits are closed with it, and open speaking requests are closed too (a Left change is published when hands were up).
cases.note: UC-37 · Deviation: at 7286680a the session ended without touching the speaking queue; the current code closes open speaking requests via SpeakingLeftAsync — SCRUM-213

cases.return: Returns at once; nothing is deleted and no session is touched.
